The '''Sebatyne nest''' was a famous [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]] bloodline, produced through the Barabel mating system (two females, two males by nest). The nest produced two generations of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] for the [[New Jedi Order]].

==Individuals==
*[[Saba Sebatyne]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and acting [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] of the New Jedi Order
*[[Tesar Sebatyne]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], son of Saba Sebatyne
*[[Bela Hara]], Jedi Knight, sister of Tesar Sebatyne
*[[Krasov Hara]], Jedi Knight, sister of Tesar Sebatyne
*[[Dordi]], Jedi Knight, created a nest with Tesar Sebatyne
*[[Zal]], Jedi Knight, created a nest with Tesar Sebatyne
*[[Wilyem]], Jedi Knight, created a nest with Tesar Sebatyne
